author: Amdb008
quote: Technically impressive, but it lost the true soul of Grand Theft Auto.Visually, Leonida is a masterpiece and the technical polish is undeniable. However, as a longtime fan of the series, I am deeply disappointed by the shift in direction and tone. GTA used to thrive on fearless, unfiltered satire that spared no one, alongside the chaotic arcade-like freedom that made the classics unforgettable. Instead, GTA 6 feels overly sanitized, playing it far too safe to avoid offending modern sensibilities. Furthermore, the heavy focus on slow-paced realism and grounded mechanics—borrowed from Red Dead Redemption 2—kills the fast, spontaneous fun that defined GTA. Great graphics cannot replace the sharp edge and rebellious identity that originally made this franchise legendary.
